beats.text: Norse god Odin never eats real food!
While other gods feast on wild boar, Odin feeds his meat to his two wolves.
He survives entirely on wine alone.
Is he a genius, or just constantly drunk? Follow for more crazy myths!
The Japanese sun goddess once hid in a cave and plunged the world into darkness!
The other gods could not drag her out.
So they threw a massive party right outside.
Curious, she peeked out and saw her own reflection in a mirror. Boom, light returned!
An Egyptian goddess almost wiped out all of humanity!
Sekhmet went on a rampage, drinking human blood.
To stop her, Ra dyed thousands of jars of beer red.
She drank it, got super drunk, and fell asleep, saving mankind! Follow for more!
King Midas thought he got the ultimate superpower, but it ruined his life!
Everything he touched turned into solid gold.
Then he tried to eat, but his food turned to metal.
He even turned his own daughter into a statue! Be careful what you wish for.
The Aztecs believed we are living under the fifth sun!
The first four suns were destroyed by monsters, floods, and fire.
To create the current sun, a humble god jumped directly into a giant fire pit.
Would you make that sacrifice to save the world?
A simple fish holds all the knowledge in the universe!
A warrior named Fionn was cooking the legendary Salmon of Wisdom.
He burned his thumb on the hot fish and licked it clean.
Instantly, all world wisdom transferred into his mind! Hit follow for smart facts!
Hercules was fighting monsters before he could even walk!
A jealous goddess sent two deadly snakes into his baby crib.
Instead of crying, tiny baby Hercules grabbed them both.
He strangled the serpents with his bare hands while giggling!
Thor once dressed up as a bride to steal back his hammer!
A giant stole it and demanded a goddess as his wife.
Thor put on a wedding dress and veil to trick the giant.
At the wedding, he grabbed his hammer and smashed the whole party!
Never look back when escaping the underworld!
Orpheus played beautiful music to rescue his dead wife.
Hades agreed, but warned him not to look back until they reached the light.
At the last second, he looked... and lost her forever. Subscribe for more tales!
The Monkey King leaped to the end of the universe just to lose a bet!
He flew past giant pillars and wrote his name on one to prove he made it.
When he returned, Buddha smiled and showed him his hand.
The pillars were actually Buddha's fingers the entire time!
